pages.title: Wardens of the groves
text: Not every March tree stands still. In each land where a [March tree](march_trees) grows, a few of its kind have stood up and walk, wearing the same wood and leaf as the tree they came from.

They are gentle. Brush one for its reagent once a minute, and tempt and breed it with **bone meal**. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though it has no gift of its own.

pages.title: Seven wardens
text: - **Hearth Warden**: the Hearthoak of the Steppe. Drops **Hearth Bark**.
- **Grove Elder**: the March tree of the Highlands groves. Drops **Elder Bark**.
- **Frostpine Sentinel**: the Frostpine of the Snow Fields. Drops **Frostpine Bark**.
- **Snagwalker**: the Cinderwood snag of the Ember Wastes. Drops **Cinder Bark** (yellow dye).
- **Weeping Warden**: the willow of the Reed Fen. Drops **Weeping Knots**.
- **Bellcap Elder**: the Bellcap of the Crystal Fields. Drops **Bellcap Spores** (magenta dye).
- **Stiltwood**: the Strider of the Shallows. Drops **Stilt Roots**.

pages.title: What they are like
text: Every walking tree has **48 health** and **8 armour**. They are slow, keep away from monsters, and walk in groups of two to four. Each drops **1 to 3** of its reagent, more with Looting.
The Glimmer Ridge grows no tree, so it has no warden. The one tree that walks and is not gentle is the [Colossus Warden](colossus_warden).

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Hearth Warden**: 1 to 3 Hearthoak Logs, up to 1 Hearthoak Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
- **Grove Elder**: 1 to 3 March Logs, up to 1 March Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
- **Frostpine Sentinel**: 1 to 3 Frostpine Logs, up to 1 Frostpine Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
- **Snagwalker**: 1 to 3 Cinderwood Logs, up to 1 Cinderwood Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
- **Weeping Warden**: 1 to 3 Willow Logs, up to 1 Willow Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
- **Bellcap Elder**: 1 to 3 Bellcap Logs, up to 1 Bellcap Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
- **Stiltwood**: 1 to 3 Strider Logs, up to 1 Strider Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.
